title: Co-Operative Societies Reforms Order Punjab Second Amendment Act 1973

sections.shortTitle: Co-Operative Societies Reforms Order Punjab Second Amendment Act 1973
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ACT VII OF 1973
ACT VII OF 1973
CO-OPERATIVE
SOCIETIES (REFORMS) ORDER (PUNJAB SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973
An Act further to
amend the Co-operative Societies (Reforms)
Order, 1972 (P. O.
No. 9 of 1972), in its application to
the Province of
the Punjab
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 24th March 1973]
(First published, after having
received the assent of the Governor of the Punjab, in the Gazette of the Punjab
(Extraordinary), dated the 24th March 1973).
No.
PAP/Legis-2(19)/73/62.-----The Cooperative Societies (Reforms) Order
(Punjab Second Amendment) Bill, 1973 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab on the 21st day of March 1973, and assented to by the
Governor of the Punjab on the 24th day of March 1973, is hereby pub lished as
an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the Punjab.
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Co-operative Societies
(Reforms) Order (Punjab Second Amendment) Act, 1973.
(2) It shall extend to the whole
of the Punjab. (3) It shall come into force at once.

2. Amendment of Article 5 of
P. O. No. 9 of 1972.-----In the Co-operative Societies (Reforms) order,
1972 (P. O. No. 9 of 1972), in Its application to the Province of the Punjab,
in Article 5, in Clause 6, for the words" on a date between the 1st day of
February, 1973, and 30th day of April 1973" the words "on a date
between the 1st day of July, 1973 and 31st day of August 1973" shall be
substituted.

the coming into force of this Act.
